_comment: SeaweedFS S3 credentials. Without this file the S3 gateway runs with NO
authentication at all — anyone who can reach port 8333 could read or
delete every image in every dataset. The ports are bound to 127.0.0.1 in
docker-compose.yml, but defence in depth is the point: a future change
that exposes the port should not also remove the only access control.
The keys deliberately match the previous MinIO defaults so MINIO_ACCESS_KEY
and MINIO_SECRET_KEY in .env keep working unchanged. Change both here and
in .env together if you change them at all.
